name: Pertamina / Pertamina Enduro
note: Title sponsor of the Pertamina Enduro VR46 Racing Team in the 2026 MotoGP season (livery launched 14 Jan 2026, motogp.com / team Sponsors page) and title sponsor of the Pertamina Grand Prix of Indonesia (motogp.com/en/sponsors). Owner chain: the Enduro brand belongs to PT Pertamina Lubricants, 99.96% held by PT Pertamina Patra Niaga, PT Pertamina (Persero)'s downstream subholding (pertamina-enduro-ownership); PT Pertamina (Persero) is an Indonesian state-owned enterprise and Danantara, the state wealth fund, consolidated its downstream units under Patra Niaga in early 2026 (pertamina-government-ownership). The state record used is indonesia-hrw-record (HRW World Report 2026 plus the UN-experts coverage in Mongabay).

why.text: Pertamina Enduro is the brand of PT Pertamina Lubricants, 99.96% owned by PT Pertamina Patra Niaga, the downstream subholding of PT Pertamina (Persero) — an Indonesian state-owned enterprise whose downstream units were consolidated under the state fund Danantara in 2026. The Indonesian state therefore controls the sponsor. Indonesia's record includes the forcible displacement of Indigenous communities and deforestation under the Merauke food-estate project in Papua, backed by the deployment of five new battalions, documented by Human Rights Watch and by UN rights experts; plus military expansion into civilian posts and excessive force against protesters across 107 cities in August 2025.
